releaseTitle: Managed Runtime Diagnostic Identity Fidelity Repair
verifiedBaseline: Latest installed real-device evidence: `3.0.0-alpha.5.95 / Engine 1.6.31 / Manager 1.3.5 / READY / model-category feature PASS / diagnostic identity FAIL because CLI was displayed as Models 1.251.0`; last fully accepted product baseline remains 5.94 until this repair is physically verified.

authority.e18: derived-impact smoke only; no authority change
authority.e19: shift-left validation reuse; no authority change

highlights: Managed CLI and managed Models diagnostics now keep separate version identities end to end instead of sharing a generic version field.
Full and compact Diagnostics use the same local truth resolver and fail closed when Engine and Manager report conflicting component versions.
Model-category classification and the exact @llmgateway/cli 1.10.0 + @llmgateway/models 1.251.0 managed pair remain unchanged.
No new network request, CLI invocation, timer, poller, persistence owner, request identity field, or catalog projection is added.
diagnosticHints: Verify Product 5.96 · Engine 1.6.32 · Manager 1.3.5 and READY/Health ok.
Full Diagnostics must show @llmgateway/cli 1.10.0 and @llmgateway/models 1.251.0 on separate lines without version overwrite.
Compact Diagnostics must show Engine 1.6.32 · Manager 1.3.5 · CLI 1.10.0 · Models 1.251.0 · ready.
Existing Premium/Regular/UNKNOWN model-category fidelity, Billing Cycle, Premium, PAYG, Cost Drivers, request ledger, cache, tier, outcome and HTTP-status behavior must remain unchanged.
